hints.title: Distinct Positive Values
hints.text: In each operation, subtracting the minimum positive value eliminates all instances of that smallest value.

hints.title: Operation Invariant
hints.text: Each subtraction round reduces the count of distinct positive integers in the array by exactly one.

hints.title: Set Cardinality
hints.text: The minimum number of operations equals the count of unique positive numbers in nums.

hints.title: Distinct Positive Filter Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass inserting positive numbers into a set.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating subtraction step by step takes O(n * k) where k is the number of rounds.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that each operation eliminates one distinct positive element.
